messages:
Olivia (Finance): billing-bot flagged a big GPU spend spike in project 'playground-trials' — +120% vs 7d avg. dashboard: https://redwood.app/billing/projects/playground-trials/overview cc @Prakash @David
billing-bot: ALERT: project=playground-trials period=last_24h gpu_cost=73.4k (avg_7d=33.2k) top_cost_centers=[trial-cust-42, internal-evals, ad-hoc-experiments] — run /billing/export?range=24h to fetch CSV
Prakash (FinOps): yikes. can someone paste the CSV or top instance groups? want to attribute to teams/customers before we ping execs
David (Infra): checking autoscaler logs now. quick check: looks like a canary job kicked off with min_nodes=10 and didn't scale down for ~18h. could be the test harness in playground that launched heavy batch runs
Sara (Platform Ops): pls confirm whether those are labeled. we rely on label:costCenter and label:customer to build attribution. if infra launched unlabelled VMs they'd show up as "unattributed"
Olivia (Finance): attached billing-bot CSV export: top rows (anonymized):
```
project,instance_group,cost,labels
playground-trials,canary-eval-01,28,500,customer=trial-cust-42;costCenter=research
playground-trials,ad-hoc-queue-7,19,200,customer=internal-evals;costCenter=platform
playground-trials,ray-cluster-x,12,300,customer=trial-cust-42
```
Prakash (FinOps): looks like trial-cust-42 is ~60% of the spike, internal-evals ~25%. next step: attribute to sales trial vs internal experiment and decide on chargeback or credits
David (Infra): confirmed: canary-eval-01 created by CI job `ci/playground-canary` — job had `autoscale.min_replicas=10` override. infra PR to revert: https://git.redwood/infra/merge/5234 — I'll patch the job to respect default min=1
Sara (Platform Ops): for immediate relief we can add a temporary budget alert for playground-trials and throttle non-prod queues. Olivia, can you approve throttling?
Olivia (Finance): approve the temporary throttle and chargeback assessment. also request Prakash to prepare a one-page with attribution and recommendation for credits vs invoice charge
Prakash (FinOps): will pull detailed hourly breakdown and map to customers. ETA 2 hours. also propose a small automation: fail CI if canary min_replicas > 3 for non-prod projects
David (Infra): will add a linting check in CI and a rollback patch now. for backfill tagging, we have 7 days of instance-level logs — can backfill labels for ray-cluster-x using launch metadata
billing-bot: NOTE: created budget alert for project=playground-trials threshold=80% of monthly budget; recipients=[olivia@redwood.com,prakash@redwood.com]
Olivia (Finance): thanks team. once Prakash posts the attribution table we'll share with GTM and the trial owner. tagging follow-up: @Sara please add playbook steps to prevent unlabeled test runs
Sara (Platform Ops): on it — will add to runbook + CI lint. leaving a TODO to notify product trial owners when spend > $5k/day.
Prakash (FinOps): posting hourly CSV in the thread in 90m with mappings. closing loop after that. :thumbsup:
